typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	loadtbllvlTwoDetailConfirms_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		{Asset Class} as string,
		{Process Method} as string,
		Type as string,
		PC as string,
		Qty as string,
		asOfDate as string,
		manager as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> fromconfirmscsv
fromconfirmscsv derive({Copy of manager} = manager,
		{Copy of PC} = toInteger(PC),
		{Copy of Type} = Type,
		{Copy of asOfDate} = toTimestamp(toString(asOfDate, 'MM/dd/yyyy'), 'MM/dd/yyyy'),
		{Copy of Qty} = toInteger(Qty)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		pc as integer,
		manager as string,
		qty as integer,
		assetClass as string,
		type as string,
		asOfDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		processMethod as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		pc = {Copy of PC},
		manager = {Copy of manager},
		qty = {Copy of Qty},
		assetClass = {Copy of Asset Class},
		type = {Copy of Type},
		asOfDate = {Copy of asOfDate},
		processMethod = {Copy of Process Method}),
	partitionFileNames:[($loadtbllvlTwoDetailConfirms_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> loadtbllvlTwoDetailConfirms
